description: Q-score benchmark CLI. 'sweep' runs a config across problem sizes; 'run' evaluates a single instance. Flags declared here need no Python change.

sweep.description: Run a config-driven sweep; flags override individual config paths.

arguments.help: Problem type: max-cut or max-clique
Solver name (obliq-*, Photonic_CVARVQE, QAOA, Simulated_Annealing, tabu, ...)
Comma-separated list of graph sizes to sweep
Number of instances per graph size
Base RNG seed (incremented per instance)
Per-instance solver timeout (seconds)
Reads/samples for QPU / Simulated Annealing solvers
Parallel worker processes (1 = sequential)
Store each instance's exact optimum alongside the results
Hardware provider (QAOA): local simulator, ibm, qi
Backend name (QAOA) or Quandela platform (photonic), e.g. sim:ascella, qpu:ascella
JSON object merged into solver_options

run.description: Evaluate a single instance without a config file.

arguments.help: Problem type
Problem size
Solver name
Instance seed (selects the graph; the solver seed is derived from it)
Solver timeout (seconds)
Reads/samples for QPU / Simulated Annealing solvers
Hardware provider (QAOA)
Backend name (QAOA) or Quandela platform (photonic)
Smallest size that enforces process-based timeouts
JSON object of solver-specific keyword arguments
Score beta against this instance's own optimum instead of the asymptotic baselines
